items.name: vit-gpt2-image-captioning
items.summary: Vit-GPT2图像描述模型是一个将视觉内容转化为自然语言描述的智能系统，解决了图像理解与文本生成之间的语义鸿沟问题。该模型采用Vision Transformer提取图像特征，再通过GPT-2解码器生成连贯的文字描述，实现了从像素到语义的端到端处理。开发者可通过Hugging Face接口快速调用该模型为图片添加说明，或基于特定领域数据微调模型，应用于智能相册管理、无障碍辅助工具等场景，让计算机真正'看懂'图像内容。
items.summary_en: Vit-GPT2 Image Captioning is a vision-language model that automatically generates descriptive text for images, bridging visual understanding with natural language. It combines Vision Transformer (ViT) for image feature extraction with GPT-2 for text generation, enabling coherent caption production from pixel inputs. You can use it via Hugging Face's pipeline API to caption photos, enhance accessibility tools, or fine-tune it on domain-specific datasets for customized image description tasks.
